notes.title: Shikkoku no Sharnoth: crash bug fixed & messy code solution
notes.content:
In response to the lagging or crashing problem during the game, we have located the cause and released an update with the updated version ID 7892979 and above to fix the lagging and flashing problem.

Q: How do I check my current version?
A: You can check whether the current version ID is 7892979 or by right-clicking the game in Steam library and selecting "Properties - Update".

Q: How do I update my game version?
A: You can quit the game and wait for Steam to update automatically; or right-click the game in the Steam library and select "Properties - Local Files - Verify the integrity of the game file" to update immediately.

Q: How can I solve the garbled code problem?
A: The problem of garbled code is caused by the engine and the system itself. At present, the official Chinese version only supports Windows Simplified Chinese system, please make sure the system is Simplified Chinese environment. You can check whether your system is in Simplified Chinese in "Windows Settings - Time & Language - Region & Language" and make changes.

Q: How can I communicate if I have more feedback?
A：Welcome to join our official QQ group 831107672; also welcome to contact iMoe Games official QQ: 2377502578.
When you leave a message, please use "Bug Description + System Information" to give your feedback, and you can get the system information in "Steam - Help - System Information".


Thank you for your support, we apologize most sincerely to those who encountered various problems with the game, and welcome your feedback.

notes.title: Shikkoku no Sharnoth is now available!
notes.content:
[h3] Shikkoku no Sharnoth has been officially launched! [/h3]
Thanks to your support, the first [b]special price of 20% off[/b], the special offer lasts for one week ~

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

Q: What languages does the game support?
A: Currently only Simplified Chinese is supported, no other language versions are supported at this time. To get the best experience, [b]please make sure to run in Simplified Chinese[/b]. You can check if your system is in Simplified Chinese in "Windows Settings - Time & Language - Region & Language".

Q: How can I get more new news?
A: Follow us on [url=https://weibo.com/imoegames]Weibo[/url], or join the official QQ group: 831107672.

Q：How do I communicate if I have questions and want to give feedback?
A：Welcome to join our official QQ group 831107672, or directly contact iMoe Games official QQ: 2377502578.
